author: Cosmos (seat that also designs C4; authored 2026-10-08 AFTER seeing candidate L-0003), ubu003

task_support.symbols: any integer; kicked subset = fixed pseudo-random fraction per symbol

K.units: rad per step at full coherence
K.meaning: mean-field coupling pulling each phase toward the population rhythm

kappa.meaning: phase kick an observed symbol gives its subset

frac.meaning: share of oscillators a symbol kicks

R.meaning: how many oscillators the policy can see (readout bottleneck)

reset.meaning: chance a phase is redrawn uniformly (catastrophic forgetting)

wseed.meaning: quenched draw of natural frequencies and symbol subsets (sampled per world, R-STAT B3)

natural_distribution.note: lists of 3 are lattices; pairs are uniform real intervals

history_free_control.meaning: every phase is redrawn each step before the kick, so the state after a step depends only on the current symbol and noise

readout_features: cos/sin of the first R phases
full_state: cos/sin of all N phases (the whole causal state; the circle embedded without a seam)
randomness: noise(n, rng) -> {n: phase noise, u: reset draws, v: new phases}
